# GitHub Automation

This folder contains repository-hosted automation and contribution templates.

- `workflows/validate-scaffold.yml` validates shell syntax, target-project Git isolation, routing configuration, runtime skill parity, and whitespace on pushes and pull requests.
- `ISSUE_TEMPLATE/` provides issue forms/templates when enabled by the repository host.
- `pull_request_template.md` provides the expected pull-request summary structure.

Repository governance and branch authority are defined in `docs/REPOSITORY_GOVERNANCE.md`, `CODEOWNERS`, and `CONTRIBUTING.md`.
